title: At wharf
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：at　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 at 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the operator kept the switch ① at dawn at the screen, and everybody in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning: the switch had been left ② at the far end of the wharf, and nobody had asked a single question. The operator had come to the station two shifts earlier and spoke little of the station he had left behind him.

The log for June 1983 puts it plainer. It was done ③ at a single word, and the trainee who kept the switch had checked it ④ at the hands of the old nurse twice before the winter came; nothing in the station was ever done at a single word in those days. The trainee wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every shift thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ at the sight of it, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ at the old man; he was not a man who explained himself, and the station had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1996 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was that the switch be checked ⑦ at the point of a knife, and that the names be written ⑧ at the foot of the page. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried at the point of a knife.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1999 she kept the switch ⑨ at dawn again when nobody else would, and ⑩ at the far end of the wharf, she said in 2001, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the switch in the same screen for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the station never forgot what had been done at the far end of the wharf.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在（某点）（表时间：at dawn）
B. prep. 在（某点）（表处所：at the far end of the wharf）
C. prep. 向（表方式／状态：at a single word）
D. prep. 向（引出施动者或相关的人：be checked at the hands of the old nurse）
E. prep. 在（某点）（表原因：at the sight of it）
F. prep. 向（表对象／目的：at the old man）
G. prep. 在（某点）（表工具／材料：at the point of a knife）
H. prep. 向（表载体／处所：written at the foot of the page）

items.q: at the far end of the wharf
at the hands of the old nurse
at the point of a knife
at the foot of the page
at the far end of the wharf, she said

answers.why: at 意为“在（某点）”，此处引出时间 dawn（天亮时分），说明那件小小的开关是在何时留下的。
at 意为“在（某点）”，此处引出处所 the far end of the wharf（码头尽头），说明东西被放在何处。
at 意为“向”，此处引出方式或状态 a single word（一句话），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
at 意为“向”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 老护士的手：be checked at the hands of the old nurse。
at 意为“在（某点）”，此处引出原因 the sight of it（一见到它），说明整件事由何而起。
at 意为“向”，此处引出对象或目的 the old man（那位老人）。
at 意为“在（某点）”，此处引出工具或材料 the point of a knife（刀尖）。
at 意为“向”，此处引出载体 the foot of the page（页脚处）：names written at the foot of the page。
at 意为“在（某点）”，1999 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的开关，此处仍引出时间 dawn。
at 意为“在（某点）”，母亲 2001 年那句话引出的仍是那一处码头尽头。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年天亮时分前后，操作员把那件小小的开关留在了屏幕。（at dawn）
那件小小的开关被放在码头尽头，谁也没有过问。（at the far end of the wharf）
整件事是一句话做成的，运行日志上写得明白。（at a single word）
入冬之前，那件小小的开关已经由老护士的手查过两回。（be checked at the hands of the old nurse）
叔叔说，整件事是由一见到它起的。（at the sight of it）
他说，家里从来没有人为那位老人做过这件事。（at the old man）
answers: In 1989 the operator kept the switch at dawn at the screen.
The switch had been left at the far end of the wharf, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done at a single word, or so the log says.
The switch had been checked at the hands of the old nurse twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun at the sight of it.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it at the old man.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 at 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the operator kept the switch at dawn, and nobody forgot it.
The switch had been left at the far end of the wharf for three shifts.
The work was done at a single word, as it always was in those days.
The switch had been checked at the hands of the old nurse twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the switch at dawn again when nobody else would.
The whole station never forgot what had been done at the far end of the wharf.
